subject: Scope freeze, readiness slam and staggered rollout sequencing
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Scope freeze, readiness slam and rollout sequencing

Team and Tara —

We're running a focused "readiness slam" this week to lock scope, validate enablement assets, and set a staggered production sequence for the new inference feature set. Goal: firm decisions on scope and rollout sequencing by EOD tomorrow so engineering can schedule the final change window.

Key asks (please treat as action items):
- Scope freeze: highlight anything that must be removed or deferred from the GA scope by EOD tomorrow.
- Docs & enablement: confirm owners for API changelog, migration guide, and customer playbooks.
- Rollout sequencing: propose tiering (canary -> tiered customers -> all customers) and any exceptions (e.g., ACME).

Attached: readiness slam agenda + initial rollout matrix. We'll run a 60-minute slam on 2027-04-28 10:00 PT to walk through open items. Please RSVP and add any pre-read notes to the Drive folder (link below).

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai

Attachments: 20270426-readiness-slam-agenda.pdf, staggered-rollout-matrix.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scope freeze, readiness slam and rollout sequencing

Diego — thanks for the plan. Quick notes from docs/enablement side:

- Changelog & migration guide: there is a gap in the API examples for the new streaming responses; I can take owner for the migration guide but need one reviewer from runtime (Marcus).
- Customer playbooks: Marissa + Vanessa, can you collaborate on a onepager for ACME (they've asked for a pre-launch runbook)?
- Training slot: if we keep the slam on 4/28, I can batch the docs review items into a morning pass and have a draft by 4/30.

I'll mark the API examples as a blocker if Marcus can't commit to review before 4/30.

Laura Bennett

- Need ACME-specific examples from Tara (sample prompts, expected QPS, and any model tuning they've requested).
- We should lock two enablement rehearsal slots: 5/3 11:00 PT and 5/4 14:00 PT (30–45m each). Please confirm availability.

I'll drop the draft slides into the Drive folder and flag any content gaps. Attachment: enablement-slides-draft.pptx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-26T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scope freeze, readiness slam and rollout sequencing

Diego — a couple of infra/runtime constraints to surface before scope freeze:

- GPU pool capacity: the dedicated pool scheduled for this release will be tight for the first two weeks post-GA; running all canaries + tiered customers concurrently will likely push us over our latency SLOs.
- Suggested approach: stagger by customer tier and throttle per-tenant QPS. For ACME specifically, because of the contract size, we can prioritize a near-immediate onboarding but we should confirm a burst plan or temporary capacity bump (I filed INF-4321).

If we decide on a staggered sequence, I can provide a per-tenant throttling config and an exception runbook for ACME. But I need a firm decision on tiers by EOD tomorrow to plan capacity.

Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-26T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Canary plan notes + fallback behavior

Diego — drafting the canary checklist now. High level plan:

1) Canary cohort: 2 internal tenants + 1 small external customer (no mission-critical SLA). Run for 48 hours and watch 95p latency, error rate, and token cost.
2) Tiered expand: stagger customers in 24–48h windows grouped by expected QPS.
3) Fallback: automatic downgrade to "compatible-smaller" model variant if token latency or error rate breach thresholds for >15m; auto-notify ops + product.

I'll upload the annotated rollout matrix (staggered-rollout-matrix.xlsx) with per-tenant thresholds. Marcus — I'll reference INF-4321 for capacity planning.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Scope freeze, readiness slam and rollout sequencing — decisions and owners

Thanks everyone — consolidating decisions and action items so they're clear ahead of the 4/28 slam.

Decisions (agreed):
- Scope freeze: all non-critical UX polish items deferred to v1.1; GA scope locked to the items in the attached matrix.
- Rollout sequencing: adopt staggered rollout (canary -> tiered customers -> general availability). ACME will be an exception and placed in tier 1 pending capacity confirmation.
- Fallback: implement automatic downgrade to the smaller compatible model variant on threshold breaches (Karthik to own).

Action owners & deadlines:
- Docs & migration guide: Laura to deliver draft by 2027-04-30; Marcus to review by 2027-04-30.
- Enablement slides & ACME runbook: Marissa + Vanessa to deliver versions by 2027-05-02.
- Capacity plan & exception runbook for ACME: Marcus to update INF-4321 and confirm capacity bump plan by 2027-04-30.
- Canary checklist & rollout matrix: Karthik to finalize matrix and thresholds by 2027-04-28 morning.

Follow-up: readiness slam scheduled 2027-04-28 10:00 PT (60m). Please add pre-reads to the Drive folder and post any blocking issues in INF-4321.

Tara — thanks for being flexible; we'll reach out separately on the ACME-specific runbook and the procurement timeline.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
Diego: +1 (415) 555-0187
